name: ScrollTiltCards
description: Feature cards inside a smooth-scroll viewport rotate in 3D as they enter from below, settle perfectly flat at the viewport center, and tilt away again as they leave the top, with scale, depth shadow and glow tied to scroll position.
a11yNotes: The viewport is a focusable role="region" labelled by the title, so keyboard users can Tab to it and scroll with arrows/Page keys/Space (native) with a 2px :focus-visible outline. Wheel input is smoothed only while the viewport can still move and is released at the top/bottom edge so the page keeps scrolling; touch and scrollbar dragging stay native. Cards are a list with real text; glow and grid layers are aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion the wheel is not intercepted and cards render flat with no rotation, scale or fade.

propsApi.name: items
propsApi.default: ['Realtime sync', 'Edge caching', 'Typed APIs', 'Audit trails', 'Instant rollbacks', 'Usage insights']
propsApi.description: Card titles, one tilting card per item.

propsApi.name: title
propsApi.description: Heading shown above the cards (also the region label).

propsApi.name: tiltAngle
propsApi.description: Maximum rotation in degrees while a card enters or leaves.

propsApi.name: perspective
propsApi.description: CSS perspective distance in px; smaller values look more dramatic.

propsApi.name: axis
propsApi.description: Rotation axis: x tips cards forward/back, y swings them sideways.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Accent color for card glow and index numbers.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the component's own scroll viewport in px (width is always 100%).

propsApi.name: borderRadius
propsApi.description: Corner radius of the viewport in px.

propsApi.name: lerp
propsApi.description: Interpolation factor per 60fps frame for wheel smoothing (0.05 floaty, 0.3 snappy).

propsApi.name: wheelMultiplier
propsApi.description: Multiplier applied to wheel and trackpad deltas.

propsApi.name: smooth
propsApi.description: Enable smooth wheel scrolling; false (or prefers-reduced-motion) uses native scrolling.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
